changelog:
movie-search 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Enables searching for movie and TV show download and streaming links by Chinese or English title (optionally with year).
- Automatically extracts title, year, and type (movie or series) from user input.
- Groups resource links by type: HD downloads (YTS), BT/magnet links (international & domestic sites), online streaming (Chinese and overseas platforms), and subtitles.
- Provides search tips, conditional formatting, and emphasizes relevant resources based on language and type.
- Triggers on a wide range of movie/TV search-related queries, prioritizing user convenience.
